summary: Stantec Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit, Amending Agreement No. 3, which modifies its existing credit agreement. Amendments include extending the Revolving Credit Maturity Date to June 18, 2031, adjusting Term Credit (Tranche B) and (Tranche C) Maturity Dates, deleting the Adjusted Term SOFR definition and replacing references with Term SOFR, and updating the Material Acquisition threshold. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is involved. This is a routine credit facility amendment.
